name: agent-record
description: Repo conventions for holding an authoritative record that agents can work from.

plugins.name: system-of-record
plugins.description: A convention for repos that hold the authoritative record of something real: sources vs renderings, the evidence rule, the capture rule, greppable uncertainty markers, a fact-routing table, and a declared perimeter. Ships a bootstrap skill that interviews, scaffolds, and installs the checks.
